narration: [chintu] <bookmark mark='chintu'/>Adding ten might cause a carry, so we cannot know the new digital root.
<bookmark mark='carry'/>A carry does change the digits, as when ninety four becomes one hundred four.
<bookmark mark='wait'/>But the digital root is not about which digits we see.

narration: <bookmark mark='check'/>To check, make up any eight digit number with root five, add ten, and find the new root.
<bookmark mark='rule'/>Adding ten is adding nine and one, so the digital root goes up by one.
